name: Side Eye High
storyline: The year is 1997 in the small, suspicious town of Ravenvale Heights, and students at the local high school are turning up dead under mysterious circumstances. The unsettling string of student deaths has the community on edge, as each incident is bizarre and sometimes even darkly ridiculous in its occurrence. Stepping in to uncover the truth is Murph, a weary, grizzled ex-detective who has been sent undercover as a “safety auditor” at the school. Over the course of one week, Murph must discretely investigate these so-called “accidents” and figure out what’s really going on before the culprit (or the truth behind the incidents) slips away. The premise sets the stage for a tense whodunit cloaked in the everyday facade of a 1990s high school, where nothing is as innocent as it seems.
summary: Investigate student deaths inside a 1997 American high school. Inspect everything, collect evidence, and piece together what happened in a grounded point-and-click detective mystery.
